test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate direct form of the given sentence.**

Veena informed me that there would be an online art class for the children at 4 o’clock that day.

options.text: Veena said to me, “There was an online art class for the children at 4 o’clock today.”
Veena said to me, “There is an online art class for the children at 4 o’clock that day.”
Veena said to me, “There will be an online art class for the children at 4 o’clock today.”
Veena said to me, “There will be an online art class for the children at 4 o’clock that day.”

solution:
The correct answer is **Veena said to me, “There will be an online art class for the children at 4 o’clock today.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The rules for changing Indirect Speech to Direct Speech:
 
 
• The given sentence is in Future Tense.
 
• In Future Tense would changes to will.
 
• Insert the commas and inverted commas.
 
• Do not use that in the sentence of direct speech.
 
• The reporting verb informed is changed in said to as per the nature of the sentence.
 
 
• Example: *John said to me, "There will be a seminar" *(Direct speech)
